note: Hisabkar uses a single version number shared by both the frontend and backend (see package.json in each repo). Every release below covers whatever changed on either side.

eras.title: Browser-only app
eras.description: Everything ran in the browser — no server, no database.

eras.title: Backend & database
eras.description: A real Node.js/Express API and database replaced browser-only storage.

eras.title: Chat, AI & PWA
eras.description: Real-time chat, an AI assistant, offline installable PWA, and the dark/gold theme.

changes.text: Sign-in screen now shows a real preview of your recent group balances (cached locally after your last visit) instead of sample data, once you've logged in at least once
Warmer gold background treatment on the sign-in screen
Fixed the Legal pages and What's New header sitting under the iPhone notch/Dynamic Island
Terms, Privacy Policy, Disclaimer, and About Us pages redesigned to match the dark/gold theme, with a tab bar to switch between them
Terms, Privacy Policy, and Disclaimer expanded with real content covering group chat, the AI assistant, notifications, and third-party services
Open Expenses (groups, expenses, settlements) redesigned to match the dark/gold theme
Add Member support added for existing groups in Open Expenses

Fixed several Open Expenses layout bugs: a background seam above page headers, stat numbers overflowing their card, the Add Expense form not scrolling, and the group-name field losing focus when creating a group
New dark/gold theme added across the app
Full mobile-first redesign: navbar, modals, alerts, group details, expense cards, add-expense form, budget UI, chat & AI assistant screens, create-group/add-member flows, sign-in and home pages
Net balance shown directly on the group list
Fixed a database connection issue on the backend
Fixed group-members cache not refreshing after a profile/availability update
Fixed stale group spending and member totals caused by the Redis cache not invalidating after expense or membership changes
Redis caching added for expenses and simplified settlements (faster loads)
App converted into an installable, offline-capable PWA
Infinite scrolling added to the expense list

versions.title: Real-time chat added

changes.text: In-app group chat added, with typing indicator

versions.note: Second major milestone: the chat/AI/PWA/theme era begins here and continues through the 3.x releases above.

changes.text: Keep-alive job added so the server doesn't cold-start
Try-it demo group added so new users can preview the app without signing up
Group ID encryption/decryption, meta tags/SEO added
Rate limiter added to backend APIs
Backend converted to a serverless deployment
New loader and success/confirmation page added
Legal pages added (Terms, Privacy, Disclaimer, About)
Download group data as Excel added
Service worker groundwork for push notifications added
"Who owes whom" settlement pairs calculation added
Group details and expense pages built out

versions.title: Real backend and database introduced

changes.text: Dedicated Node.js/Express backend created with its own database
Register, Login, Create/Join Group, Add/Edit/Delete Expense APIs added
Frontend rebuilt on Tailwind CSS and Redux Toolkit
Full authentication flow wired up end to end

versions.note: First major milestone: before this release the app only ran in the browser with no server or database behind it.

versions.title: Totals summary
versions.note: Last release of the frontend-only era.

changes.text: New welcome screen with walkthrough video
End-to-end create-group → add-expense → view flow completed

versions.title: Hisabkar launches (frontend only)

changes.text: First working version of the app

versions.note: The very first release — a browser-only app with no backend or database, and not yet a PWA.
